en.hubeali: Ali Bin Muhammad, from some of our companions who said,

‘Abu Muhammad<sup>asws</sup> (11<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>) was submitted (for custody) to an animal keeper, and he<sup>asws</sup> was constricting upon him<sup>asws</sup> and was hurting him<sup>asws</sup>.

So his wife said to him, ‘Woe be unto you! Fear Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Do you not know who is in your house?’ And she introduced him<sup>asws</sup> of his<sup>asws</sup> righteousness and she said, ‘I fear upon you from him<sup>asws</sup>’.
So he said, ‘I shall throw himasws between the predatory animals’. Then he did that with himasws, and heasws was seen standing praying Salat and they were around himasws’.
